caption: A white-bearded man in a grey suit and round glasses holds a white mug by its handle in his right hand, the cup already at chest level, with a white sheet at the lower right. To the left, a silver-and-black robotic arm with a two-finger gripper and a small camera-like head is visible against a grey backdrop. The man raises the mug, its rim climbing from his chest toward his face while his gaze stays lowered toward the cup. As the rim meets his lips midway through the movement, he tilts the mug upward into a sipping posture and holds it there. His eyes remain downcast, looking down past the rim rather than forward. The robot arm's position shifts toward the lower-left corner, while the man keeps the mug at his mouth until the end.
